title: NoChat
description: Allow people to toggle chat on / off
body:
NoChat is a lightweight and easy-to-use plugin that gives players and administrators control over their chat experience.
Perfect for focused gameplay or managing server-wide events.

Features:
- Personal Toggle: Players can disable their own chat. When disabled, they can't send messages.
- Global Toggle: Administrators can disable the entire server chat with one command.
- Admin Bypass: Staff members can still talk even when the global chat is disabled.
- Fully Customizable: All messages and prefixes can be changed in the config.yml.
- Color Support: Supports standard color codes (&).
  
Commands:
- /nochat: Toggles your own personal chat.
- /nochat server: Toggles the global server chat (Admin only).
  
Permissions:
- nochat.use: Allows players to toggle their own chat (Default: everyone).
- nochat.admin: Allows use of the server toggle and bypasses global mutes (Default: OP).
